Here is my final answer: --- ## 🍫 Easy Microwave Chocolate Cake **Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/140772/easy-microwave-chocolate-cake/ ### ✅ Criteria Met: - **Prep Time:** 5 minutes (less than 30 minutes ✓) - **Contains Chocolate:** Yes — uses cocoa powder ✓ - **User Rating:** 4.2 stars out of 5 (based on 240 ratings) ✓ ### 📝 Description "This microwave chocolate cake is quick and easy to make and cooks in the microwave in 2 minutes. And it tastes great, really! The consistency is dense and cakey. It would go well with chocolate (or your favorite) chips or nuts or served warm with hot fudge. This cake, 'born' out of a pregnancy craving, worked out amazingly." — Submitted by Laura ### 🥣 Ingredients 1. Nonstick cooking spray 2. ¼ cup white sugar 3. ¼ cup milk 4. 1 large egg 5. 3 tablespoons butter, softened 6. 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 7. ½ cup all-purpose flour 8. **2 tablespoons cocoa powder** (the chocolate ingredient) 9. ¼ teaspoon baking powder 10. 1 pinch salt **Yield:** 2 servings ### 👨‍🍳 Step-by-Step Instructions 1. **Prep the bowl:** Spray a medium microwave-safe bowl with nonstick cooking spray; set aside. 2. **Mix the batter:** Combine sugar, milk, egg, butter, and vanilla in a mixing bowl; mix well. Combine flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl. Blend the flour mixture into the milk mixture until smooth. Pour into the prepared microwave-safe bowl. 3. **Microwave:** Cover and cook in the microwave on high until the cake springs back when touched, 2 to 2½ minutes. Allow the cake to cool for 5 minutes, then cover the bowl with a plate and invert the cake onto the plate. --- **Bonus Info:** - Cook Time: 2 mins - Total Time: 7 mins - Per serving: 433 calories, 21g fat, 54g carbs, 9g protein This recipe is perfect for a quick chocolate dessert craving and meets all your specified criteria.
